chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAmr ibn Thābit, from Jābir, who said:
I asked Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“And from the people are those who take peers besides Allah; they love them as the love of Allah.”
He said: “By Allah, they are the associates of so-and-so and so-and-so; they took them as Imams besides the Imam whom Allah made an Imam for the people.”

“So for that reason He said: ‘And if those who were unjust could but see, when they see the punishment, that all strength belongs to Allah altogether, and that Allah is severe in punishment. When those who were followed disown those who followed them, and they see the punishment, and the ties between them are cut off. And those who followed will say: If only we had another return, then we would disown them as they have disowned us. Thus Allah will show them their deeds as regrets upon them, and they shall not exit from the Fire.’”
Then Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) said: “By Allah, O Jābir, they are the Imams of oppression and their followers.”

key_terms.أَئِمَّةً: leaders taken as Imams for guidance and authority
key_terms.أَنْدَادًا: rivals or peers taken besides Allah
key_terms.الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا: those who committed wrongdoing or injustice

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Baqir (عليه السلام) interpret Qur'an 2:165-167 regarding those who follow illegitimate leaders?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of the verse about those who take rivals besides Allah by applying it to those who follow illegitimate leaders instead of the Imam appointed by Allah. It links wrongful allegiance in this world to disavowal, regret, and punishment in the Hereafter. The narration emphasizes the theological and communal significance of rightful Imamate in Shia teaching.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Amro Bin Sabit, from Jabir who said,
‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[2:165] And from the people there are ones who take for themselves objects of worship besides Allah, whom they love as they love Allah.

By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! They are the friends of so and so (Abu Bakr) and so and so (Umar). They are taking them as imams (leaders) besides whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had Made to be as the Imams<sup>asws</sup> for the people.

Thus, due to that, Heazwj Said [2:165] and if those who are unjust had seen, the Punishment when they see it, that the Power is wholly Allah's and that Allah is Severe in requiting (evil). [2:166] When those who were followed shall renounce those who followed (them), and they see the Punishment and their ties are cut asunder. And Heazwj Said [2:167] And those who followed shall say: Had there been for us a return, then we would renounce them as they have renounced us. Thus will Allah Show them their deeds to be intense regret to them, and they shall not be coming out from the Fire’.
Then Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! They are the unjust imams (leaders) and their adherents’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from ‘Umar ibn Thabit from Jabir who has said the following.
“I asked abu Ja‘far (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious,
“Some people consider certain things equal to God and love them just as one should love God. . .” [2:165]

The Imam (a.s.) said, “They, by Allah, are the friends of so and so and so and so whom they have taken as their Imams and not the Imam, Leaders with Divine Authority, who are appoint for people as suCh

For this reason He has said, “. . Had the unjust been able to reflect about their condition, when facing the torment, they would have had no doubt that to God belongs All-power and that He is stern in His retribution. [2:165] When the leaders see the torment and lose all their resources, they will denounce their followers [2:166]. The followers will say, “Had we had the chance we also would have denounced our leaders.” That is how God will show them their regrettable deeds. They will not be able to escape from hell fire.” [2:167].)
Then abu Ja‘far (a.s.) said, “By Allah, O Jabir, they are the unjust Imams and their followers.”
